branch.verdict.unknown: {tips} tips · cannot compare (a copy has no upstream or another one)

settings.title: Settings
settings.note: Changes apply at once and are saved to widget.json.
settings.closeAction.hint: While hidden in the tray the app stops refreshing. Click the tray icon to bring it back.
settings.windowOnTop.hint: Same as the pin button in the title bar.
settings.autostart.hint: Only an installed app is registered.
settings.autostartDev: A development build cannot turn this on. Use the installed app.
settings.autostartFailed: Could not change Start with Windows: {text}
settings.startMinimized.hint: Refreshing goes on; the taskbar icon and the tray tooltip show the state.
settings.theme.hint: Ctrl+Shift+D switches between light and dark.
settings.themeDurationMs.hint: How long the colors take to change. 0 switches at once, and so does Windows with animation effects off.
settings.openTarget.hint: Right-click a slot and choose Open (Ctrl+O) to open its folder in this program. The Unity editor opens from Open in Unity in the same menu.
settings.idleSecs.hint: A full refresh runs PowerShell once (about a second).
settings.gitFullMins.hint: Also counts local-only commits, branches and stash.
settings.signalSecs.hint: Looks only at the Unity processes and the slot files. It goes on while minimized and stops with refreshing while hidden in the tray.
settings.localOnlyWarnDays.hint: When the oldest one is this old.
settings.flashTaskbar: Flash the taskbar on a new risk
settings.flashTaskbar.hint: When an editor start stalls or the commit charge passes the critical value.
settings.branchViewOpenFork.hint: After «See every slot in Fork» refreshes the branch view repository, open it in Fork. Slot repositories are never written.
settings.branchView.none: No branch view repository yet. The core setting branchView.root decides where it goes.
settings.unitySlotScript.hint: Empty: found through install.json, then PATH. A folder or unity-slot.cmd works too.
settings.sampleFile.hint: For development and screenshots. Usually empty.
settings.detectedNone: Not found. Run unity-slot once; it records its location in the state folder.
